label: POST-HOC, UNREGISTERED, ARITHMETIC ONLY on values already certified by l227_static.py. No branch depends on it.

contradiction.reading: The crossing is a statement about the SIGN test's weakness, not about the magnitude test's adequacy: at the crossing the recommended instrument has power 0.075. A threshold derived from where two power curves CROSS is reported in units of the WEAKER instrument and therefore answers a different question than 'at what mirror does my instrument stop working'.

power_floor.reading: The |mirror r| at which the magnitude test loses half its power is 0.2386 at the lane's own measured effect size and 0.7941 at beta = 0.50 — a factor of 3.33. So the card's requested ONE-LINE RULE does not exist as a single number: the threshold is a 2-D condition in (mirror, effect size). The only mirror-ONLY statement that is unconditional is the analytic one: at |r| = 1 the magnitude test has EXACTLY zero power (measured: max|diff| == 0.0, p_D == 1 in every draw).

retro.reading: At the measured mirror coefficient and the lane's own effect size, the magnitude head-to-head was running at about 23% power. L214's Q3 therefore read H_TIE at roughly one-quarter power: 'tie' was never distinguishable from 'difference' on that data. This IS the retro-flag the card expected — but it is delivered by POWER AT THE MEASURED MIRROR, not by the crossing criterion the card implicitly assumed, which the measured pair does NOT reach (0.683 < 0.830). The card's registered expectation is false as stated and true in substance, and the two differ precisely because a crossing threshold depends on the rival instrument.

pre_step: 1. Name which currency each candidate instrument CONSUMES (a mean-|rho| statistic consumes the per-cell correlations; a sign-agreement statistic consumes the per-cell currency means). Compute the mirror coefficient in THAT currency, with AVERAGE (midrank) ranks.

2. If the two currencies are related by a strictly monotone map (check the definitions, not the data), the magnitude head-to-head has exactly zero power: do not register it. This is a PROOF and it fires before any measurement.

3. Otherwise compute the ACHIEVED POWER of the magnitude test at the measured mirror AND the measured effect size (a 20-cell, 16-seed simulation costs seconds). Register the magnitude test only if that power clears a stated bar.

4. If it does not, the honest verdict on a null result is 'underpowered instrument', never 'tie' — and the remedy is more cells or a different statistic, NOT automatically the sign comparison, whose own power at n = 20 topped out at 0.135 across the whole mirror grid.

pair4_tie_mechanism.reading: The stored means are 3-decimal rounded, so 56 distinct unrounded values collapse to 55 distinct stored values. The relation is a perfect monotone aggregation, yet its midrank Spearman reads 0.9999829 rather than 1: ROUNDING A STORED VALUE MANUFACTURES TIES, and ties cap a rank correlation below its analytic value. Same law as 0h, from the opposite direction.
